# Nikah.com — Matrimonial Advertising & Profile Sharing Service

> Nikah.com is an ethical matrimonial advertising and profile-sharing platform based in Malappuram, Kerala, India. It helps individuals and families discover and connect with genuine marriage proposals with respect, transparency, and privacy.

## Important Entity Definition & Disclaimer
- **What Nikah.com IS**: A digital matrimonial advertising and profile-sharing platform.
- **What Nikah.com is NOT**: Nikah.com is **NOT** a matrimonial broker, marriage bureau, or matchmaking agency.
- **No Marriage Decisions**: Nikah.com does not arrange marriages or make decisions on behalf of users or families.
- **Independent Verification**: Users are strongly advised to independently verify the background, identity, and suitability of any proposal.

## Main Pages
- [Home Page](https://nikah.com/): Overview of services, how profile sharing works, testimonials, and FAQs.
- [About Us](https://nikah.com/about): Mission, vision, core values, and operating principles.
- [Contact Support](https://nikah.com/contact): Direct WhatsApp support, phone inquiries, and office location in Malappuram, Kerala.
- [Terms & Disclaimer](https://nikah.com/terms): Complete matrimonial advertising terms, subscription policies, and legal disclaimers.
- [Privacy & Customer Policy](https://nikah.com/privacy): Data handling practices and profile removal request guidelines.

## How Our Service Works
1. **Profile Submission**: Families and individuals submit matrimonial details directly or through authorized contributors via WhatsApp.
2. **Review & Preparation**: Profiles are reviewed and formatted respectfully for advertising.
3. **Profile Sharing**: Profiles are advertised across the website, social channels, and WhatsApp networks.
4. **Direct Family Connection**: Interested parties connect directly with the profile's family without broker fees or intermediation.

## Privacy & Profile Removal
- We respect customer privacy and user wishes.
- Anyone can request prompt profile removal or data update by contacting our official WhatsApp support with the profile details or URL.
